g.text: Three Stores, Three Very Different Sizes
Aggregating is what shrinks a 500PB raw stream down to a serving-sized table
bounded by lateness window, not click volume
smaller than the raw stream it summarizes
Each store is sized and retained for its OWN purpose: raw log for audit, dedup cache for correctness during
the lateness window only, aggregate store for what advertisers actually query -- none of the three is a copy of another.
